english.meaning: in the beginning, before things changed
english.note: 初頭唔肯 means at first refused.

exampleSentences.english: Yeah, at first I thought I’d buy a lot of things in Italy.
exampleSentences.traditional: 嗯，同埋呢意大利我初頭諗住好多嘢買啊。
